limitations.quote: update both forms of its pointer on the same edge
limitations.note: The rewrite fixed the write increment but removed the existing one-cycle Gray-pointer lag and gated RAM enables during reset, changing flag and transfer timing that the reference preserves.
The test enforced the rewrite’s immediate full-boundary behavior and used the DUT’s flags to count transfers, rather than independently checking the expected cycle-by-cycle flag timing.

limitations.note: The cleanup command caused the entire simulation invocation to be rejected and resubmitted, and the later diff check failed because the workspace was not a Git repository.
